result.summary: Fixes malformed Doxygen annotations across existing comments and enables the Clang compiler warning flag -Wdocumentation-unknown-command in the build configuration. It ensures comment blocks with Doxygen tags use recognized comment syntax and verbatim blocks where appropriate so tools can parse and verify them.
result.problem: Misspelled Doxygen command tags such as '@peer[in]' instead of '@param[in]' or Doxygen tags placed inside regular '/*' comment blocks are silently ignored by Doxygen and bypassed by Clang's existing -Wdocumentation checks.
evidence: Commit 2c8c91c5a0 demonstrates a concrete warning caught in net_processing.cpp:717 where '@peer[in]' was used instead of '@param[in]', which was previously ignored by -Wdocumentation.
result.scope_notes: Touches documentation comment blocks across 13 files and updates build flags to enable a compiler warning.
result.card: Fixes malformed Doxygen comment blocks and enables Clang's -Wdocumentation-unknown-command compiler warning. Misspelled Doxygen commands like @peer[in] instead of @param[in], or tags placed inside standard non-Doxygen comment blocks, were previously ignored without compiler diagnostics. Enabling this warning catches documentation syntax mistakes in developer builds and CI.

risk.why: A mistake in compiler warning configuration could fail builds on certain Clang versions, but code edits only touch comments and have no runtime impact.
